questions.q: When our flight was cancelled, the airline offered ___ for our hotel.
questions.explainRo: **Offer** este urmat de **to + infinitiv**: offered to pay.

questions.q: At a flea market in Bucharest, my dad ___ with the seller for twenty minutes over an old camera.
questions.explainRo: **Haggle (with someone over something)** = a se tocmi la preț, exact ce se face la un târg de vechituri.

questions.q: The travel agency pays me a ___ every month, so I fix their website whenever something breaks.
questions.explainRo: **Retainer** = sumă fixă plătită lunar ca să fii disponibil pentru suport și modificări.

questions.ro: Taximetristul a refuzat să-mi accepte cardul.
questions.explainRo: **Refuse** este urmat de **to + infinitiv**: refused to take.

questions.q: Adopting a puppy is a huge ___ (angajament) – you can't just give it back after a month.
questions.explainRo: **Commitment** = angajament, o responsabilitate pe termen lung pe care ți-o asumi.

questions.audio: Is the decision-maker joining today's call?
answers: Is the decision-maker joining today's call?
Is the decision maker joining today's call?
questions.ro: Persoana care ia decizia participă la apelul de azi?
questions.explainRo: **Decision-maker** = persoana care ia decizia finală – e important să fie prezentă la apel.

questions.q: Even though it was my birthday, my grandmother insisted ___ for the whole dinner.
questions.explainRo: **Insist** cere **on + -ing**: insisted on paying, nu „insisted to pay”.

questions.q: The hotel manager thanked us ___ (leave) such a nice review.
questions.explainRo: **Thank someone for + -ing**: prepoziția **for** este obligatorie, iar verbul vine cu -ing.

questions.ro: Fostul meu șef m-a încurajat să devin freelancer.
questions.explainRo: **Encourage** are tiparul **verb + obiect + to + infinitiv**: encouraged me to go.

questions.q: At first, the new developer denied ___ (push) untested code to production, but the Git history showed his name.
questions.explainRo: **Deny** este urmat de **-ing** (sau **having + V3**), niciodată de „to push”.

questions.q: The support agent ___ the refund would take five working days.
questions.explainRo: **Explain** nu primește direct persoana: explained **to me** that…, nu „explained me that”.

questions.ro: Ea a sugerat să ne întâlnim în holul hotelului.
answers: She suggested meeting in the hotel lobby.
She suggested that we meet in the hotel lobby.
She suggested that we should meet in the hotel lobby.
She suggested we meet in the hotel lobby.
She suggested we should meet in the hotel lobby.
She suggested meeting in the lobby of the hotel.
She suggested that we meet in the lobby of the hotel.
She suggested that we should meet in the lobby of the hotel.
She suggested we meet in the lobby of the hotel.
She suggested we should meet in the lobby of the hotel.
questions.explainRo: **Suggest + -ing** sau **suggest that we (should) meet**; „suggested us to meet” este greșit.
